statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail eases to the low band because the post-keynote decline has been fully retraced and volatility is decaying, while Stress stays elevated on a live front-end rates repricing.
recommendation: Conditions are described as an orderly, resolved two-way response to a hawkish rates-first repricing, with the residual conditional risk concentrated in the narrow 15:00Z-16:00Z window. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ fully retraces the post-Warsh decline and turns positive on the day as VIX decays, leaving Tail in the low band with Stress elevated on front-end repricing
body:
The Warsh keynote printed at 14:00Z and the equity response has now resolved. NQ futures trade at 29,768.50, up 0.24% on the day, after setting the session low at 29,505.00 in the hour following the speech. The entire post-keynote decline has been retraced and the contract is back near the upper part of a 29,505.00-29,810.75 range. The Nasdaq-100 cash index is 29,727.65, up 0.29% from Thursday's 29,641.56 close, inside a 29,459.30-29,752.78 day range. A full retracement of a directional impulse immediately after the week's largest scheduled catalyst is the clearest available evidence that mean reversion is functioning, which is why Tail eases from 17 to 14 rather than building.

Volatility is decaying alongside the recovery. VIX is 14.24, down 1.86% on the day and near its 14.17 session low, below Thursday's 14.51 close. That is the ordinary post-event pattern of an uncertainty premium being released once a scheduled catalyst has passed, and it argues against a developing one-way path.

The rates channel remains the live transmission and is the reason Stress stays elevated at 51. The 2-year yield is 4.33%, about nine basis points higher on the day, while the 30-year is 5.18%, roughly two basis points lower, and the 10-year is 4.70%. That bear-flattening shape is a genuine hawkish repricing of the near-term policy path. Warsh committed to "a discipline, not to a decision," said the Fed "must be confident that underlying inflation is moving to our objective, clearly and at sufficient speed," and cited PCE at 3.7% over twelve months and 4.1% over six.

Cross-assets are not aligned behind one directional story. Equities are rising while front-end yields rise and long-end yields fall, which is conflict rather than confirmation, and conflict of that kind belongs in Stress, not Tail. WTI is $83.19 and Brent $88.21, both down less than half a percent, keeping the Middle East situation priced as a diplomatic and sanctions question rather than a physical supply threat.

The residual conditional risk is that the recovery leg itself extends into the U.S. afternoon without pullbacks. That has not been observed: price is roughly forty points below the 29,810.75 session high rather than pinned to it, and the danger window is therefore narrowed to 15:00Z-16:00Z. The forecast decays from 16:00Z on the base case of continued orderly discovery, with a small structural step up for the final cash hour into the 20:00Z close. From the 21:00Z Globex weekly halt the horizon is a closed market, where a pathological continuous price path has no mechanism, so conditional Tail falls to its weekend floor while Confidence declines with the age of the last live observation.

Shared Finviz cross-asset context was collected at 07:07Z and is outside the 90-minute freshness bound, so this assessment rests entirely on independent current research.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON state throughout, with Tail between 11 and 17 and Stress between 46 and 57. Thursday's late U.S. session and the overnight hours held a narrow futures range with the mode consistently mixed, while Stress drifted higher from 48 to 57 through the European morning as the concentrated 14:00Z catalyst stack approached. Tail rose only at 13:00Z and 14:00Z, to 13 and then 17, as the keynote printed and the session low was set, and it never left the low band because no persistent one-way structure developed. One hour, 10:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon has three phases. The current 15:00Z hour is the resolution hour: the keynote has printed, the post-event decline is fully retraced and volatility is decaying, so the narrow 15:00Z-16:00Z danger window covers only the residual repricing risk. From 16:00Z the conditional path decays on the base case of orderly two-way discovery, with a small structural step up for the final cash hour into the 20:00Z close to reflect Friday closing positioning ahead of the Monday month-end turn. From the 21:00Z Globex weekly halt through the end of the horizon the market is closed, conditional Tail sits at its weekend floor because a continuous pathological price path has no mechanism, and Confidence declines steadily with the age of the last live observation.
